title: Starting on trombone in the Gibbs High School band
summary: A grandfather on the instrument committee lets him choose the trombone; he starts in the Little Rock high school band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: S N U B   M O S L E Y
TELL ME ABOUT YOUR FAMILY AND ALL. TELL ME ABOUT GROWING UP IN LITTLE ROCK. WHAT GOT YOU STARTED ON MUSIC?

My Grand-dad was the head of a committee that bought up a gang of instruments and gave them to the high schools. By my grand-dad being the head of the committee I had my choice of any instrument I wanted in the band. So, I choose the trombone as a little kid. In fact, I have a little picture of me when I first started. I was only playing about two or three months. That's how I started---in the high school band.
Gibbs High School in Little Rock, Arkansas.
